By LADY HOSIE, Author of " Brave New China," etc. MODERN Chinese women live in two areas of China : the part dominated by the Japanese and Free China, where those, who could, managed to flee to the shelter and leadership of the Generalissimo and Madame Chiang Kai-shek. article_title: ELECTRICITY AND THE MODERN CHINESE WOMAN
brief_extract: It began with the freeing of their feet, just as sometimes I think that the emancipation of the women of the West was simultaneous with the freeing of our waists. It was in 1920 that I saw with delighted eyes one of the first shoe shops in Shanghai selling neat leather shoes for Chinese ladies ; and, best of all, there was a queue in the shop. There are few things more annoying than to hear people say that it is a pity China was ever awakened by the West.
